gen-gf-gabarito-gf-gothic-a1: Gothic A1 feels approachable and professional, with a splayed c terminal. Gabarito has no hairlines to squint at, so the heading can drop to a modest size and stay legible.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-gotu: Expressive Gabarito keeps every line at a steady thickness, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. And Gotu underneath carries only a faint modulation, visible mainly when you look closely.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-gowun-dodum: Distinctive Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. Gowun Dodum settles in below with a wide mouth on the lowercase a and a smooth, tube-like line.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-gruppo: Gruppo is a clean sans-serif whose curve endings never come near each other. Gabarito does its best work as a tubelike, constant-weight heading, and Gruppo does its best in the text underneath.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-gudea: Gudea is approachable and modern, with glass-clear gaps between terminal and stroke. Gabarito's one-nib heading, its terminals cut open so counters flow outward, is the single most memorable quality here.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-host-grotesk: Host Grotesk reads contemporary, its curves sweeping open rather than curling closed. Gabarito's bowls hold no swelling at all, which lets the heading and the sans beneath it sit together smoothly.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-hubot-sans: Gabarito draws monoline strokes throughout, with terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. And Hubot Sans, its e opened wide, gives that heading a contemporary sans to settle beside.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic: IBM Plex Sans Arabic is clean and approachable, with easily readable open apertures that keep each word clear. Under Gabarito's wire-bent s curves, whole paragraphs would flow along smoothly.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-ibm-plex-sans-devanag: One nib seems to have drawn every Gabarito letter, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. IBM Plex Sans Devanagari adds rope-loose curves that never knot at the ends.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew: Approachable and contemporary, IBM Plex Sans Hebrew leaves its s and c uncrowded. Following Gabarito's downstrokes, free of any calligraphic swell, paragraphs would drift past without snagging the eye.
